name: web-pixel-gradient-square-grid-background
title: Square-tile gradient from white to deep blue
whatItIs: A rectangular pattern of small rounded squares arranged in a dense grid whose colour fades from white at the top through light blue to deep navy at the bottom, with tile sizes shrinking near the bottom.
whatItMeans: Calm and digital; a stepped gradient reads like a pixelated sky or sunset.
techniques: Render a gradient as a grid of small tiles rather than a smooth blend.
Vary tile size or gap along the gradient to add rhythm.
Keep one hue family from white to navy.
Use the pattern as a hero or divider background.
bestFor: Textures for social covers and posters

vocabulary.definition: A gradient built from discrete squares.
A regular grid of square cells.
A smooth progression of one hue from light to dark.
A pattern that adds surface without content.
